description: This file defines the PHP class I18NLangString, which represents a language string entity for internationalization in the OrangeHRM system. It includes ORM mappings, properties, and getter/setter methods associated with language string data, such as unit ID, value, group association, note, and version.

classes.name: I18NLangString
classes.description: Entity class representing an internationalization language string with ORM mappings, properties, and accessor methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the language string.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the language string.

methods.name: getUnitId
methods.description: Returns the unit ID associated with the language string.

methods.name: setUnitId
methods.description: Sets the unit ID associated with the language string.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the associated I18NGroup entity, if any.

methods.name: setGroup
methods.description: Associates an I18NGroup entity with this language string.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the language string.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the language string.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the optional note associated with the language string.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the optional note for the language string.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string, if any.
